The '''Z-95C4d Headhunter''' was a common [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] variant built as a [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] for ground support.<ref name="SWS" /> It was outfitted with additional [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]]-racks and ordnance hard-points.<ref name="DB" />
